newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson expects a couple of good years.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson expects a couple of good years.

text.p: Swedish telecommunication company AB LM Ericsson's said its proposed higher dividend for 1996 of 2.50 crowns a share from 1.75 crowns should be seen as an indication that Ericsson thinks good years are to come.
"The higher dividend should be seen as an indication that we believe we have a couple of good years ahead of us," Ericsson deputy managing directory C W Ros told a news conference.
He also said a strong positive cash flow in the fourth quarter of 1996 was behind the dividend increase.
